name: Cat-Cow
cueShort: Round spine up (cat), then drop belly down (cow). Full spinal wave.
cueFull: On all fours, hands under shoulders. Cat: exhale and round entire spine toward ceiling, tuck chin and pelvis. Cow: inhale, let belly drop, lift head and tailbone. Move slowly and continuously, one breath per movement.

name: Glute Bridge
cueShort: Press feet down, squeeze glutes, hips to a straight line. Hold 1–2 sec at top.
cueFull: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat on floor hip-width apart. Drive hips up until body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze glutes hard at top. Lower slowly over 2 seconds. Push through glutes, not lower back.

name: Hip Circles
cueShort: Large circles with hips, upper body still. Both directions.
cueFull: Stand feet hip-width, hands on hips. Draw large circles with your hips — forward, side, back, side. Keep upper body still. Complete all reps one direction then reverse.

name: Thoracic Rotation
cueShort: Rotate upper body, hips locked forward. Movement from mid-back.
cueFull: Sit cross-legged or kneel, hands lightly behind head, elbows wide. Keeping hips still and facing forward, rotate upper body to the right as far as comfortable. Pause, then rotate left. Movement comes from mid-back, not hips.

name: Jumping Jacks
cueShort: Light springy landing, soft knees. Don't crash down on heels.
cueFull: Stand feet together, arms at sides. Jump feet out to shoulder width while raising arms overhead. Jump back to start. Land softly with a slight bend in the knees.

name: Brisk March
cueShort: Drive knees to hip height, opposite arm swing, upright posture.
cueFull: March on the spot, lifting knees to hip height or as high as comfortable. Swing opposite arms naturally. Keep upright posture; don't lean forward.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
cueShort: Hinge at hips (not squat down), flat back, dumbbells close to legs. Drive hips forward to stand.
cueFull: Stand feet hip-width, dumbbell in each hand at thighs. Push hips back and hinge forward — dumbbells lower down front of thighs. Keep back flat, chest up. Lower until hamstring stretch (roughly shin level). Drive hips forward to stand, squeeze glutes at top.

name: Goblet Squat
cueShort: Chest up, knees out over toes, heels flat. Dumbbell at chest as counterweight.
cueFull: Hold one dumbbell at chest, feet slightly wider than hip-width, toes turned out 15–30°. Brace core, push knees out over toes as you lower. Descend until thighs parallel or as low as comfortable. Heels flat. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cueShort: Lead with elbow toward hip (not shoulder). Slow 2–3 sec lowering phase.
cueFull: Place one hand and knee on a bench for support. Hold dumbbell in other hand, arm hanging straight down. Pull dumbbell toward hip — drive elbow back and up. Squeeze shoulder blade at top. Lower slowly over 2–3 seconds.

name: Reverse Lunge
cueShort: Step back far enough so front shin stays vertical. Both knees ~90° at bottom.
cueFull: Stand upright, dumbbell in each hand. Step one foot back, land on ball of foot. Lower back knee toward floor — stop just before it touches. Both knees at ~90°. Drive through front heel to stand. Alternate legs or complete all reps one side.

name: Bird Dog
cueShort: Arm and leg to parallel only. Hips level. Hold 2 sec at top. Slow.
cueFull: On all fours, hands under shoulders. Simultaneously extend right arm forward and left leg back to parallel. Hold 2 seconds, hips completely level. Return slowly. Repeat opposite side. This is a slow, controlled movement — speed kills the benefit.

name: Farmer's Carry
cueShort: Shoulders back and down, core braced, walk tall. Don't let weight pull you sideways.
cueFull: Stand holding dumbbell in each hand, arms at sides. Shoulders back and down, chest up, core braced. Walk at a steady controlled pace. Don't let the weight pull shoulders down or torso lean to one side. Breathe steadily.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
cueShort: Hip hinge only — back flat, dumbbells on thighs the whole way. Strong hamstring stretch at bottom.
cueFull: Stand feet hip-width, dumbbell in each hand resting at front of thighs. Soft bend in knees. Push hips backward and lower dumbbells down front of legs, keeping them in contact. Back flat, chest up. Lower until strong hamstring stretch (mid-shin). Squeeze glutes and drive hips forward to stand. This is your most important back rehab exercise.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cueShort: Elbows at 45° from torso. Upper arms touch floor = bottom. Touch and pause, don't bounce.
cueFull: Lie on back, dumbbell in each hand, upper arms resting on floor at 45° from torso. Press both dumbbells straight up until arms fully extended. Lower until upper arms touch floor. Pause briefly, then press again. Keep elbows at 45°, not flared to 90°.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
cueShort: Stay hinged at 45°, pull to hips not chest. Squeeze shoulder blades together at top.
cueFull: Hold dumbbell in each hand. Hinge forward at hips until torso is at roughly 45°, knees slightly bent, back flat. Pull both dumbbells up toward hips simultaneously, driving elbows back and up. Squeeze shoulder blades together at top. Lower slowly over 2–3 seconds.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cueShort: Press straight up overhead, not forward. Brace core — especially seated.
cueFull: Sit with back support (or stand). Hold dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward, elbows at ~90°. Press both dumbbells straight overhead until arms fully extended. Lower slowly back to shoulder height. Seated preferred — less spinal compression.

name: Dead Bug
cueShort: Lower back MUST stay pressed to floor the entire time. Slow. Exhale as you extend.
cueFull: Lie flat on back. Arms straight up toward ceiling. Knees at 90°, shins parallel to floor. Slowly lower right arm overhead while extending left leg out straight, hovering above floor. Return both to start. Repeat opposite side. Lower back pressed firmly to floor throughout — if it arches, reduce range of motion.

name: Suitcase Carry
cueShort: Resist the lean toward the weight. Walk as if carrying nothing. Both shoulders level.
cueFull: Stand holding one dumbbell at your side. Stand tall — resist any lean toward the weighted side. Walk at a steady controlled pace, keeping the loaded shoulder from hiking up or dropping. Complete all duration on one side, then switch.

name: Dumbbell Squat
cueShort: Chest up, knees track over toes, heels flat. Drive through heels to stand.
cueFull: Stand feet hip-width, toes slightly turned out, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Brace core, chest up. Push hips back and bend knees, lower until thighs parallel (or as low as comfortable). Heels flat, knees tracking over toes. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Push-Up
cueShort: Elbows at 45°, body rigid. Lower until chest nearly touches. No hips sagging.
cueFull: Hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms extended, body straight from head to heels. Lower chest toward floor, elbows at 45° from torso. Lower until chest nearly touches. Push back up. Keep body rigid — no hips sagging or piking. Modified: knees on floor until 3×10 full reps.

name: Alternating Reverse Lunge
cueShort: Step far back, stay upright, alternate legs continuously. Slow down if balance goes.
cueFull: Stand upright, feet together. Step right foot back, lower right knee toward floor. Drive through left heel to stand. Immediately step left foot back and repeat. Continue alternating. Step far enough back that front shin stays vertical.

name: Plank
cueShort: Squeeze glutes, brace core, body a straight line. Breathe steadily throughout.
cueFull: Forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders. Body straight from head to heels, feet hip-width. Squeeze glutes, brace core, press forearms into floor. Hips level — not sagging or piking. Breathe consistently.

name: Mountain Climbers
cueShort: Hips low and stable. Drive knees toward chest, keep arms locked, steady rhythm.
cueFull: Full push-up position, arms extended. Drive right knee toward chest, return, then immediately drive left knee. Alternate at a steady pace. Keep hips level and low, core braced. Faster for more cardio, slower for more core focus.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
cueShort: Lunge position, torso upright. Feel the stretch in the front of the rear hip.
cueFull: Step right foot forward into a lunge, left knee lowered or hovering. Shift weight forward slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of the left hip. Keep torso upright — don't lean forward. Hold 30 seconds, switch sides.
